Maya Chen: Heads-up — nightly evals (run 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC) flagged a spike of garbage/empty generations on the 'dialogue-stability' prompt set after the int8 quantized bring-up. Samples attached in the run artifacts.
Akshay Patel: ugh, saw a couple of those. Any pattern? specific models or shutters? :thinking_face:
Maya Chen: Mostly across the new int8-distil variants, but only on some workers. Seems non-deterministic: same prompt sometimes OK, sometimes returns just a single token or repeats <unk>. Also noticed a few harness timeouts (worker 12/17) during tokenization step.
Zane Kim: eval-bot posted these errors in the job logs:

```
ERROR eval.harness: tokenizer produced invalid token id 0 for special token <bos>
WARNING sampler: sequence truncated due to repeated 0 id
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/eval/runner.py", line 412, in run
    tokens = tokenizer.encode(prompt)
  File "/opt/venv/tokenizers/wrappers.py", line 87, in encode
    raise TokenizerError('Null id mapped for special token')
TokenizerError: Null id mapped for special token
```

Zane Kim: looks like tokenizer special token mapping collapsed to 0 for some shards.
Julia Ortega: library change in quantize pipeline? I remember a recent PR that remapped special token offsets to match packed weights. @akshay did that land in staging?
Akshay Patel: I merged a patch that rewrote `tokenizer_config.json` during quantize to map offsets -> packed indices. It was intended to be idempotent but iirc we only tested on full-precision artifacts. Could be a bug in short-file paths for sharded models.
Maya Chen: repro steps I ran (simple):
1) pull quantized artifact `redwood/model-x-int8:v2`
2) run `python -m eval.harness --prompt-set dialogue-stability --model-path ./model`
3) sometimes returns correct outputs, sometimes single token "\u0000"

Maya Chen: I bisected to a small script that shows tokenizer.json for affected artifacts has "special_tokens": {"bos": 0, "eos": 1} while full-precision has bos=50256.
Akshay Patel: that explains the repeated 0 id. Most decoders treat 0 as either padding or NULL which collapses the beam.
Zane Kim: can reproduce locally when I intentionally rewrite `special_tokens` to 0. Also saw the harness worker that timed out stuck in `tokenizer.encode` waiting on a bad external C extension call sequence.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: nightly-eval-2026-03-18 reported 3 failed workers, 7 warnings. https://ci.redwood.internal/job/ev-runs/2026-03-18/1234
Julia Ortega: quick mitigation: we should make the harness validate special token ids on startup and fail fast with a clear message. I'll open an issue and a tiny PR to add a check.
Maya Chen: created minimal issue: https://git.redwood/eng/eval-harness/issues/3421 — includes sample artifact and failing logs.
Akshay Patel: i'm pushing a hotfix to the quantize postprocess that preserves `special_tokens` absolute ids instead of remapping them. If that lands, we should rerun nightly. Draft PR: https://git.redwood/eng/models/pulls/569
Zane Kim: also adding a test to the harness that decodes a few known prompt->token sequences across quantized shards to catch this in CI.
Julia Ortega: for the timeout flakiness, let's also enable a short watchdog on tokenizer C calls in the harness so it doesn't hang the whole worker for 10+ minutes.
Maya Chen: cool. timeline? this looks high-severity — affects customer-facing releases if we promote this quantized build.
Akshay Patel: hotfix in staging now. Rerun queued. If green, will cherry-pick to release branch.
Maya Chen: thanks. once nightly rerun completes i'll post summary. :thumbsup:
eval-bot: nightly-run 2026-03-18 finished (rerun after hotfix): 1/120 failed prompts (regression resolved), 0 worker timeouts. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/ev-runs/2026-03-18/1234/retry
Maya Chen: confirmed — rerun looks good. leaving the harness validation and the additional CI tests open as follow-ups. Closing thread once PRs merge.
